component.name: HuberClaude
component.summary: Open-source coding agent CLI for Linux, built for OpenRouter

description.p: HuberClaude is a coding agent that runs in your terminal and is dedicated to OpenRouter: a single key gives access to thousands of models, with prices in plain sight. It streams responses and supports sub-agents, web search, MCP, skills and hooks.
/model ships with recommended models by tier (FREE to HIGH) and /usage shows your OpenRouter balance as a fuel gauge.
No keys or URLs are bundled: run /login after installing to paste your own. Commands: huber or huberclaude.
